say:0:1524636001:0.text: Hurry up! We're running out of time!
say:0:1524636001:0.source_cn: 抓紧时间收割，再晚就来不及了！

say:1:1524636002:0.text: There's still wheat waiting to be harvested... I'll lend them a hand.
say:1:1524636002:0.source_cn: 还剩一些麦子没有收割……去帮帮他们吧。
